title: Load-sensitive GUI test timed out in the full-suite push gate
summary: The ORCH-0013 push gate (full suite) failed on tests/test_orchestrator_surfaces.py::test_gui_controls_pause_and_gate_decision: the run was still READY when the test's 30 s deadline for APPROVAL_REQUIRED expired. The same test passed 3/3 in isolation and in all 12 earlier gates, and the pass changed no GUI/engine code (trace.py, CLI entry, records), so it is a load-sensitive timeout, not a regression. Per the operator's gate rule the loop stopped without pushing. The deadline was raised to 90 s (the sibling test uses 60 s); the next pass reruns the gate.
